$comment: The registry of libraries under test. `status` is the state of the ADAPTER, not the library's accessibility. Never publish a score for a target whose adapter has not been reviewed.

targets.name: React Spectrum
targets.notes: Calibration control. Widely regarded as the accessibility gold standard. If the harness does not score this near-perfect, the harness is wrong. Scores 12/12 on dialog against 3.47.3.

targets.name: Radix UI
targets.notes: Reference adapter implementation. Read this one first when writing a new adapter.

targets.name: shadcn/ui
targets.notes: Not installed — generated. Identified by CLI version and generation date (shadcn@4.16.1, 2026-08-04, new-york style) rather than a package version. Dialog, menu, tabs and accordion are built on Radix; the combobox is built on Base UI.

targets.name: MUI
targets.notes: Mounted with library exports only and no hand-written ARIA. MUI documents several ARIA attributes as the developer’s responsibility; see the adapter notes carried on every result.

targets.name: Ant Design
targets.notes: NOT PUBLISHABLE. First-run scores were dominated by adapter bugs of ours: combobox moved 27% -> 94% and accordion 42% -> 85% after correcting a visibility check and a v5 class name. Remaining failures are unverified — see docs/DECISIONS.md 016 for exactly which are confirmed and which are still open.
